features.name: backing_plate
features.description: Minimal rounded-corner backing plate below the socket floor (decorative sewing terraces + flange of the original are DROPPED). Provides the mounting face and the socket floor.

features.name: floor_rails
features.description: Inverted-U tongue on the socket floor: two thin rails (2.15 wide, in X) running lengthwise in Y, joined by a rounded bridge at the far (+Y closed) end, with a wide central slot between them. Rails stop short of the mouth. They set the cleat blade's seating height (rail 3 + blade 4.02 ~= socket depth 7).

features.name: socket_body_walls
features.description: Outer socket footprint (28.2 x 40.1) with ~3.5 mm side walls rising from the floor (z=0) to the standoff top (z=10). Inner cavity 21.2 (X) x 33 (Y) open toward +Z. The mouth (-Y) end is FULLY OPEN for lengthwise cleat entry; the far (+Y) end is closed by the arch bridge end wall.

features.name: capture_lips
features.description: Inward-curling capture lips occupying the TOP 3 mm of the two LONG side walls AND the far (+Y) arch end wall. Each overhangs inward ~2 mm, narrowing the opening above z=7 so the cavity is ~7 mm deep under the lip. Traps the cleat blade's back face. NO lip at the mouth (-Y open end).

printOrientation.bed_face: backing-plate bottom face (z=-2.5) on the bed; socket opens straight up (+Z)
printOrientation.note: Recommended orientation is mouth-UP / on-back (socket opening toward the nozzle, backing plate on the bed). This is the natural manifold orientation and matches the design's +Z. See printability flags.

printabilityFlags.detail: The inward lips (top 3 mm of long walls + arch end) overhang inward ~2 mm/side. Printed mouth-up they are a downward-facing ~2 mm ledge at z=7 -> a horizontal overhang / short internal bridge of ~2 mm per side over the cavity. Below the 45-degree unsupported rule but the span is short (2 mm, well under MAX_BRIDGE_SPAN 10). Likely printable with minor bridging/overhang quality loss; may want light support or a chamfered lip underside in a later round. Faithful-nominal v1 keeps the square undercut per the reference — flagged for print-reviewer, NOT redesigned.
The far (+Y) end wall carries the same inward lip; its underside is a small downward overhang at z=7. Same short-span note as the side lips.

specDeviations.reason: Used the RESOLVED functional-loop length 40.1 (photo 17 caliper), NOT the 46.61 outermost decorative terrace, per requirements.md + reference measurements.md.

Rails centered symmetrically about X=0 from the measured central_slot (8.2) + rail_width (2.15). Effective wall->rail gap resolves to 4.35 vs the measured 4.5; the two independent short-axis sums (4.5+2.15+8.2+2.15+4.5=21.5) already overshoot the 21.2 cavity by 0.3, so ~0.15 mm is distributed. Within nominal-repro tolerance; no taper this round.
backing_thickness 2.5 + standoff_height 10.0 = 12.5; the 0.01 is a rounding artifact of the tiny geometry epsilons. Negligible.
